lede: Swipe to see how one indie label rewrote the DNA of Bengali pop: B-POP Tags on the takeover of Qinetic Music.
body:
**Qinetic Music** is, in B-POP Tags' words, the indie label that "completely rewrote the DNA of Bengali Pop." Our 7 September 2026 post called it "the insane takeover of Qinetic Music", and the cover put it even more plainly: "The label behind Bangla pop's global take over."

## Qinetic Music and the new Bangla pop

The post is a swipe-through carousel, and it makes its case slide by slide on Instagram. What the caption makes clear is the framing. This is an independent label rather than a major, and in B-POP's view it has changed what Bengali pop sounds like and how far it travels.

The cover leans into that confidence. A glossy blue "Q" with white angel wings and a golden halo floats over a dark sci-fi frame, with "SWIPE" in the corner.

## Who the post tagged

Alongside #QineticMusic, #BanglaPop and #BengaliMusic, the post tagged [@qineticmusic](https://www.instagram.com/qineticmusic/), [@qineticnetwork](https://www.instagram.com/qineticnetwork/), [@mcfaf.a](https://www.instagram.com/mcfaf.a/), [@sharafnazaar](https://www.instagram.com/sharafnazaar/) and [@jamshedps](https://www.instagram.com/jamshedps/). Follow them for the label's latest releases.

## More on Bengali pop

For artists taking Bangladeshi music worldwide, read about [Halfcian of Salted Jus](post:halfcian-salted-jus-bangladesh-global-music). For new listening, try the [B-POP x IIZXXZII playlist](post:bpop-iizxxzii-spotify-playlist) and [Rodoshi's "Arektu"](post:bodoshi-arektu-single). More is on our [music hub](topic:music) and the [B-POP Tags home page](home:).
